action_items: Fix ConnectPage runtime crash: 'Cannot access pair before initialization'.
Retest web invite generation and second-user join flow end-to-end after ConnectPage fix.
critical_code_review_comments: ConnectPage has a temporal dead zone bug: useEffect references `pair` before `const pair = ...` declaration, causing runtime crash when rendering /invite or /join.
This is a blocker for one of the core onboarding flows and should be treated as release-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Created one temporary signup user during UI test and several TEST_ content entries (message/journal/calendar) via API/UI regression tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression tests are reusable and currently passing. UI flows verified for login/signup, dashboard, messages, bently, journal, missions, calendar, settings. Invite/join UI remains blocked by ConnectPage crash; pairing can still be set up via backend endpoints.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: Login -> Settings (optional dissolve pair) -> navigate to /invite. Page turns blank and invite code element never renders. Console shows: 'Cannot access pair before initialization' from ConnectPage. Root cause: `useEffect(() => { if (pair) navigate('/dashboard'); }, [pair]);` executes before `const pair = statusQuery.data?.pair;` declaration in component scope. Mitigation: move `const pair = ...` declaration above any useEffect/useMemo references or derive pair directly inside effect from query data.
